profile.headline: AWS Principal Software Engineer at Accenture
profile.summary: Hard working, dedicated software professional.  I've worked in a variety of industries from system security to life sciences.  I enjoy learning about new technologies and how they could potentially be applied to larger software systems to provide solutions.

positions.title: AWS Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Using AWS technologies, provide managed security incident and response.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description: Work with modern technologies such as AWS Platform services and Spring to provide enterprise / cloud solutions for problems in the healthcare industry.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
I started as a Senior Software Engineer at Kewill, and was promoted to Principal Software Engineer for my strong role on the Universal Carrier Module project.  During my time at Kewill Americas, I've spent a significant amount of time working on their enterprise class shipping application – Flagship. I found and eliminated a number of thread-safety issues and established some performance regression tests. Additionally, I was a key contributor to the newest add-on which has the potential to work across a number of their applications, the Universal Carrier Module as well as its sister add-on the Universal Rules Module.  The combination of these two add-ons breathes new life into Flagship and are excellent sales enablers. Most recently, I've been working on supporting services and platform engineering using Amazon Web services.
· Promoted from Senior Software Engineer to Principal Software engineer for my strong role on the
Universal Carrier Module
· Established performance regression testing techniques and tests
· Provided more consistent implementations for various carrier modules
· Eliminated a number of thread-safety issues and memory leaks
· Improved usage of source control by upgrading to the latest SVN and branch planning to better utilize merge tracking
· Provided architecture and design guidance for the development of the Universal Carrier Module, in
addition to being a contributor to the project
· Provided leadership and assistance for other developers in terms of both design and implementation
· Upgraded code base from Visual C++ 6 to Visual Studio 2010 while maintaining compatibility with existing add-on modules
· Piloted migration from SVN to Git (the intended company standard for source control)

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
As an employee of Savant I was instrumental in the development of the product. We were a small team with no more than three developers at any given point including myself and a QA / Support engineer. Much of my time at Savant was spent doing the actual implementation of the product using mostly C for the client program, and PHP / AJAX for the server program, although I had strong involvement in the design and feature specification.
· Developed a proof of concept for a kernel-based security product for Linux.
· Studied feasibility of porting the solution to other platforms
· Productized the proof of concept into both a Windows and a Linux product
· Designed and elaborated upon features requested from product management
· Delegated tasks to other developers and assisted with code reviews and debugging
· Assisted QA wherever necessary to find and eliminate bugs
· Maintained source control (CVS transitioning to SVN), Bug tracker (Mantis) and Backup system
· Assisted with customer related bug reports and issues and in several sales situations
· Developed an enterprise management system for the product

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
I worked part-time while attending school at this small IT Services company. My largest project was the implementation of a technical assistance tracking tool which was about a six month project
mostly during the summer of 2003. The requirements and specification were set by the customer and I implemented the program using VB with Microsoft SQL and XML/XSLT. The rest of the time was spent mostly maintaining existing websites and assisting with development of new sites.
· Administered an IIS server with several websites
· Fixed some bugs on ASP websites
· Assisted with planning and development of several PHP based websites
· Assisted in the planning and design of a technical assistance tracking tool
· Implemented this tool using Visual Basic and Microsoft SQL
· Provided IT services for several small customers
· Assisted in development of training materials for Windows XP
· Studied materials for Microsoft Certified Professional exams

positions.title: ResNet Consultant
positions.description: Assisted students with IT related tasks including network connectivity issues, printer issues, etc.

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description: Typed up certificates, customer letters, data entry into QuickBooks, set up customer database to help in outputting letters more quickly and computer maintenance.
